sents.t: I think it’s quicker in some ways. One of your insights is it’s far easier to achieve our material desires than it is to renounce them.
sents.zh: 我觉得在某些方面这样更快。你有个观点是：实现物质欲望，比放下它们要容易得多。

sents.t: It depends on the person, but I think you have to try that path. If you want something, go get it.
sents.zh: 这因人而异，但我觉得你得走一走那条路。想要什么，就去争取。

sents.t: I quipped that the reason to win the game is to be free of it,
sents.zh: 我开玩笑说过，赢下这场游戏，就是为了从中解脱，

sents.t: so you play the games, you win the games, and then hopefully, you get bored of the games.
sents.zh: 所以你去玩游戏、赢游戏，然后但愿你会玩腻。

sents.t: You don’t wanna just keep looping on the same game over and over,
sents.zh: 你不会想一直在同一个游戏里一遍又一遍地打转，

sents.t: although a lot of these games are very enticing and have many levels that are relatively open-ended.
sents.zh: 虽然很多这类游戏都非常诱人，而且关卡很多，几乎没有尽头。

sents.t: Then you become free of the game, in the sense that you’re no longer trying to win it—you know you can win it—
sents.zh: 然后你就从游戏里解脱了，意思是你不再执着于赢它——你知道自己赢得了——

sents.t: and either you move to a different game or you play the game for the sheer joy of it.
sents.zh: 接下来你要么换个游戏，要么纯粹为了好玩去玩它。
